rows.en: (I see... No wonder he doesn't look our age.)
Nice to meet you, Michel-kun.
Nice to meet you too, Saotome-kun.

(I was a little nervous about school life,
but I'm glad I made friends right away...)

(I've gotta keep this up and work hard
to make school life a blast!)

(Classes start for real today... I wonder what
our Practical and Basic Training teachers are like?
I hope they're nice...)
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Class names follow the schedule help (u5459/u5460: practical training, basic training).

rows.en:
I'm the one teaching you lot "Practical Training."
The name's Gary Murdoch.
rows.notes: jitsugi kunren -> 'Practical Training' (schedule help u5459); not in the glossary.

rows.en:
And I'll be teaching "Basic Training."
Hilda V. Bergen.
rows.notes: kiso kunren -> 'Basic Training' (schedule help u5460); not in the glossary.

rows.en:
I'll drill you lousy eggs till you puke blood,
so you can at least hatch into chicks!
Look forward to it!
rows.notes: tamago yarou (egg bastards) / hiyokko (chicks): kept the egg-to-chick image.

rows.en: (Training till we puke blood...?)
Hey, Gary, don't scare the students so much.
I'm just tellin' 'em the facts, aren't I?

That's exactly what scaring them means...
Honestly. Don't take what Gary said seriously.
He's just exaggerating.

(Phew, that's a relief, then. I'm glad
Hilda-sensei seems kind, despite how
she lo...)
rows.notes: Cut off mid-word as in the Japanese (yokka...), interrupted by Hilda.

rows.en:
Because if you're puking blood in Gary's class,
people are going to die in mine...

Don't worry. Soon enough, the pain
will turn into pleasure...
(I feel like she just said something terrifying...)
You're the one scarin' 'em worse...

...That concludes the class overview.
If there are no questions, that's all for today.
Dismissed!

(Just hearing the overview was enough to tell
these classes are gonna be brutal...)

Hmm, Gary-sensei's puke-blood training...
And Hilda-sensei's, even tougher than that...

Ahh, I can't wait!
Just how intense is this training gonna be...?
Right? You think so too, don't you?

Oh, sorry, I haven't introduced myself yet!
I'm Yuuto Kagura! As friends chasing the
same dream, let's get along from here on!
Y-yeah... Nice to meet you too.

Alright, 100 laps around the field, to get
a head start on class!! See you later!
rows.notes: yoshuu mo kanete = also as advance preparation for class.

rows.en: Huh? Oh, see ya...
(Yuuto sure is a fired-up guy...)

I'm sorry. Yuuto's loved working out and training
ever since way back, and sometimes he ends up
causing trouble for the people around him...
rows.notes: Miyuki Shirakawa ('??? (woman)'). 'Ever since way back' (mukashi kara) is echoed by the player in c21215/c21244.

rows.en:
Oh, I see.
Um, and you are...?

I'm Miyuki Shirakawa.
Nice to meet you.

Yeah, nice to meet you too.
"Ever since way back"... So you and Yuuto
go way back?
Yes, we're childhood friends.
Huh, I see.
Mm-hmm, I see, I see~

He runs out of control like that sometimes,
but he's a good kid at heart, so please
be friends with him.
Roger that from me too~

Wait, you've been joining in this whole time
like it's nothing, but... who are you?

Hobby: tinkering with machines. Favorite food:
field rations. No real dislikes.
Three sizes, from the top...

Instead of all those little details,
could you just tell me your name?
Oh yeah, I left out the most important part...

The name's Yui Hoshimura!
Nice. To. Meet. Ya!
rows.notes: yo-ro-shi-ku spelled out syllable by syllable.

rows.en: ...Nice to meet you too.
(She's so hyper...)
Geez, Yui, you never change.
Shirakawa, do you know Hoshimura too?
We were in the same class in junior high.
Yup yup, me 'n' Miyuki are best buds for real.
Huh, is that s......
rows.notes: Cut off (sou na...) by Kagura's scream.

rows.en:
GWAAAAAAAH!!
My leg's crampiiing!!

But I won't let something like this beat me!
I... I can still keep going...!

Alrighty! Then I'll give ya a quick mod
so your legs never cramp again~!

Stop it!
I can't do something like cheating!
I... I want to break my limits on my own...!

Then let's just mod your whole body
and blow past human limits~!!
...Um, I'm really sorry about all this.
You don't have to apologize, Shirakawa...

(I'm glad I made all kinds of friends, but...
this school sure has a lot of quirky people.)
Huh? Oh, see you...
(Kagura-kun sure is fired up...)

Oh, I see.
Um, and you are...?

Yeah, nice to meet you too.
"Ever since way back"... So you and
Kagura-kun go way back?
Miyuki, do you know Yui too?
You don't have to apologize, Miyuki...

uncertain: c21191/c21192 (and c21190): class names jitsugi kunren / kiso kunren set as "Practical Training" / "Basic Training" from the schedule help strings (u5459/u5460); not in the glossary.
